title: Shuffle 03
name: shuffle-03
arc:
A shuffle with an arm lift. From weight over the character-right foot the character-left foot lifts at frame 4 while the character-left arm rises from the waist to above the shoulder by frame 6, folds tight at frame 8, and comes back down as the figure centres at frame 10.

Pingpong: frames 0 and 16 are grounded turnarounds.

frames.cue: Weight over the character-right foot, both feet down. legs straight. The character-right leg passes behind the character-left. on the balls of both feet, heels lifted. character-left arm at waist height, elbow straight, out to the side. character-right arm raised above shoulder, elbow bent ~90°, by the side. torso upright. character-left hip raised. character-left shoulder raised. hips turned character-left against the shoulders. head forward.
